---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea, enhancement, or new feature for KidQuest
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

## Feature Summary
A concise summary of the proposed feature or enhancement.

## Target Audience / Persona
Who is this feature for?
- [ ] Child / Quest Player
- [ ] Parent / Guardian
- [ ] Teacher / School Administrator
- [ ] Developer / Contributor

## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Describe the Solution You'd Like
A detailed explanation of how you envision this working. What are the key interactions, screens, or backend endpoints required?

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## UI/UX Mockups or References
Attach mockups, wireframes, or reference designs if available.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, edge cases, or considerations (e.g., offline mode support, notification impact, gamification point balance).
